description: '''Marina Vadimovna Zhadan''' ({{langx|uk|Марина Вадимівна Жадан}}; {{langx|ru|Марина Вадимовна Жадан}}; born 21 August 1992), known professionally as '''Mari Kraimbrery''' ({{langx|ru|Мари Краймбрери|label=none}}), is a Russian singer, songwriter, and record producer.
